SAMPLE

NAME

sample - a page to test the clean-up

SYNOPSIS

sample [-v] file

DESCRIPTION

sample reads file as cat(1) does, and writes it as printf(3) would. Options:

-v

Say more.

--width n

Lay it out n columns wide.

A second paragraph of the same option.

Exit status

0

It worked.

1

It did not.

SEE ALSO

ls(1), hotty-demo(1)
